name: masking-evidence
title: Masking evidence report
for_each: SELECT id,name FROM runs ORDER BY created_at

sections.title: Processed objects
sections.sql: SELECT object_name,row_count,columns FROM datasets WHERE run_id=$1 ORDER BY object_name

sections.title: Rule snapshot
sections.sql: SELECT p->>'object_name' AS object,p->>'field_name' AS field,p->>'action' AS action,p->>'domain' AS domain,p->>'reason' AS reason FROM runs,jsonb_array_elements(policy) p WHERE id=$1

sections.title: Review decisions
sections.sql: SELECT reviewer,decision,evidence,created_at FROM reviews WHERE run_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at
sections.note: A recorded acceptance is not proof of anonymity. Check current readiness and inspect kept fields before release.

sections.title: Purpose and retention
sections.sql: SELECT name,owner,purpose,revision,retention_due FROM environments WHERE id=$1

sections.title: Masking history
sections.sql: SELECT name,revision,row_count,created_at FROM runs WHERE environment_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at DESC

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.sql: SELECT name,owner,due,status,resolution FROM issues WHERE environment_id=$1 ORDER BY due
sections.note: No access is granted and no data is sent by this draft.
